subject: Request to shift demo window to allow workload trace & prompt validation
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thurs 6/25 at 11am PT

Hi Mina —

Quick note: a last-minute compliance review just popped onto our calendar on Thursday morning. Would it be possible to move the demo out by 48–72 hours? We want to make sure we can run our workload traces and validate the prompt set against a small sample before the live session — otherwise the demo will feel rushed.

We can provide the sample workload trace and the prompt set by EOD today if you can propose a couple of alternate windows next week.

Apologies for the change — it’s an internal gating step.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, Finlytics
[sample attachments: sample-prompt-set.json, workload-trace-2026-05.csv]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thurs 6/25 at 11am PT

Thanks for the heads up, Samir — totally understand.

We prefer to keep the demo productive rather than run through a surface-level session, so shifting makes sense. If you can drop the traces and prompt set, Diego and I will ingest them and run a short validation pass to prepare:
- we'll run a 15–20 minute dry run against the quantized model variant you requested
- validate a handful of prompt examples (edge cases, PII masking cases)
- confirm access and any S3/presigned URL permissions needed for the traces

Could you confirm whether the traces contain any customer PII that needs masking before uploading? If so, please send a masked subset and a separate secure link for the sensitive elements.

Alternate windows we have next week:
- Tue 6/30 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 7/1 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 7/2 09:00–10:00 PT

Let me know which works and whether your ops team needs a separate access checklist (we can attach one).

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thurs 6/25 at 11am PT

Mina / Marissa —

I can take the ingestion/validation on this. Plan:
1) Ingest workload-trace-2026-05.csv into a sandbox S3 bucket (read-only presigned URL from Finlytics).
2) Run a 30-minute token distribution analysis to pick representative sequences.
3) Execute prompt-set examples against the canary model variant and capture latency/cost snaps.
4) Produce a one-page dry-run summary for the demo.

Two asks for Samir / Ops:
- please confirm whether the trace includes nested PII fields (SSNs, account numbers). If yes, provide a sanitized subset and tell us where the sensitive data lives so we can avoid it in logs.
- grant presigned-read access with a 7-day expiry to avoid onboarding delays.

I can be on the call for the rescheduled demo and will share the dry-run summary ahead of time.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thurs 6/25 at 11am PT

> 
> We prefer to keep the demo productive rather than run through a surface-level session, so shifting makes sense. If you can drop the traces and prompt set, Diego and I will ingest them and run a short validation pass to prepare:

Thanks, Mina — we appreciate the willingness to do the dry run.

We will:
- upload a sanitized subset of the workload trace by EOD today (will strip direct identifiers)
- provide a presigned S3 URL (read-only, 7-day)
- attach the prompt set JSON (same file names as listed)

Proposed new demo time: Tue 6/30 10:00 PT (works for our exec sponsor). If that slot still holds on your side, please lock it and send a calendar invite.

Samir
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Thurs 6/25 at 11am PT

Perfect — locked. Calendar invite sent for Tue 2026-06-30 10:00–11:00 PT (has Zoom link).

Action items:
- Finlytics (Samir / Ops): upload sanitized workload trace & presigned S3 URL by EOD 6/24 — confirmed done.
- Diego: run ingestion + dry-run validation and share one-page summary by 6/29 — in progress (will attach summary to the event).
- Marissa: include cost/latency dashboard link in the invite and prepare 5-minute pricing overview.

Quick note: I added a short prep doc to the Drive folder (link above) with sample prompts we plan to test and the runbook for the session. If anyone sees gaps in the scope, flag them now so Diego can incorporate.

Thanks, looking forward to a focused session.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
